note: The demo write: finance agent's conclusion
title: Why the Q3 East China refund rate rose
content: The Q3 East China refund rate rose from 2.1% to 4.8% (b-101), mostly after Sep 12. Support tickets show refund complaints tripled, mainly duplicate charges at checkout (b-207). This lines up with app v5.4, released Sep 12 in East China with a new payment module that may charge twice on retry (b-318). b-318 is still unverified, so the link is likely but not confirmed.

note: Short factual summary that matches context
title: Other regions' Q3 refund rates are normal
content: North China (2.0%) and South China (2.2%) refund rates were flat in Q3, so the increase is specific to East China (b-103, b-101).

note: Public-level note about the refund process
title: Refund request process summary
content: Customers request refunds from the Orders page within 30 days; money goes back to the original payment method in 5-7 business days (b-208).
